step-1.text: Pick the spot and clear it. There are no screws in this bed, so put the screwdriver away.

count-1.text: Nothing new this step. Just you and the frame.

step-2.text: Stand the steel supports on the floor in a grid, four across and three from head to foot. Use a panel as a spacer so the gaps come out right.

step-3.text: Lay the first three panels across the head-end supports, good side up, edges tight together.

step-4.text: Next row of panels, butted tight against the first. Nudge the supports under the joints if they have drifted.

step-5.text: Run each ratchet strap round the supports and panels, three in all, and crank them until the panels pull tight with no gaps. Snug is enough, the straps only stop things shifting.

step-6.text: Push the bed into place, press on each corner to check nothing rocks, and lay the mattress on. No box spring needed.

count-6.text: Nothing new this step. Just you and the frame.

done.text: Done. Your FLOYD BED platform bed, full/queen is built. Give it a proud little pat.
